verdict.rationale: Factory's docs describe delegating a task, reviewing the diff, and merging from the App or terminal. Droid shows proposed modifications before applying anything, full code diffs render beside the session, and you can leave line-by-line inline review comments that Droid acts on, with approvals in the CLI runtime. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an approval gate that sits specifically before PR creation, any detail on the PR-creation flow itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
